name: Grouped-SPMe battery electrochemical inversion
description: infer_parameters(training_protocols, forward_model, bounds, budget) -> dictionary of exactly the grouped physical parameters in bounds. forward_model(parameters, protocol) is an evaluator-owned pinned PyBOP GroupedSPMe solve; at most 100 training calls. Independent held-out whole-SOC impedance and time-domain protocols score mean normalized complex impedance/voltage RMSE. Enforce physical parameter bounds; uncertainty/identifiability is not inferred from a point estimate. The trusted source adapter must be SHA-256 pinned and may not be candidate-supplied.

sources.locator: Hallemans et al. grouped-SPMe electrochemical impedance parameterization and time-domain validation.
Pinned Fig10 EIS fitting and Fig11 time-domain validation scripts; uses PyBOP GroupedSPMe, experimental LG M50LT measurements and OCP tables.

requirements.datasets: Pinned measured LG M50LT impedance and OCP tables;5 training SOCs, withheld40%/70% SOCs (17 frequencies each), separate measured401-point60-second drive trace. --battery preparation; isolated PyBOP25.6/PyBaMM25.6 environment.

science_relevance.scientific_problem: Infer physical electrochemical battery-model parameters from impedance measurements.
science_relevance.importance_rationale: Physical parameters support interpretable predictions of battery response across operating conditions.

papers.title: Physics-based battery model parametrisation from impedance data
